Strategy: Combine the [28,42] sweet-band bonus with a penalty just below the band, [21,27], discouraging leftovers that fall short of the sweet spot.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) - (20 if 21 <= r - item <= 27 else 0) for r in bins]
```
